definitions.gloss: affected area; diseased part; injured area
definitions.explanation: The specific part of the body that is injured, infected, or afflicted with disease. A medical term commonly used by doctors and in everyday health contexts.

examples.japanese: {患部|かんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やして→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{患部|かんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied medicine to the affected area.

examples.japanese: {患部|かんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: The affected area is swollen and painful, so you should go to the hospital soon.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard medical term used by doctors, pharmacists, and in everyday health conversations. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧ (executive, leader of an organization).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {患部|かんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧ (to cool the affected area)
- {患部|かんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to apply to the affected area)
- {患部|かんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れる→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧ (the affected area swells)
- {患部|かんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧ (to protect the affected area)
